title: Under Armour Names Gunna Global Brand Ambassador and Creative Director of P-Star
summary: Under Armour announces the appointment of multi-platinum, Grammy-nominated artist Gunna as its Global Brand Ambassador and Creative Director of P-Star, a multi-dimensional creative platform conceived under Gunna’s creative direction spanning apparel, footwear, community initiatives and cultural storytelling.
body_markdown:
P-Star is really an extension of how I live — always evolving, staying disciplined and pushing myself in every area of my life.


Under Armour understands that vision and has given me the space to build something that brings together style, performance and community. For me, it’s about moving forward, creating something meaningful and building something that can continue to grow.


Gunna


Launching on Thursday, August 27 exclusively at A Ma Maniére Atlanta and UA.com, P-Star makes its debut with a 14-piece apparel and footwear collection inspired by the rhythm of Gunna's everyday life - from training sessions and travel days to the world stage. The collection features heavyweight tees, shorts, sweats and American football-inspired HeatGear® styles, each finished with the signature embellished P-Star logo.


Headlining the launch is the UA Scorpio, a brand-new sportswear silhouette and Gunna's first-ever official footwear collaboration with Under Armour. Debuting in an exclusive “Gunna” colorway, the shoe will be available exclusively at A Ma Maniére Atlanta in a hyper-limited release before a wider release in early 2027. ** Powered by UA HOVR™ cushioning, the silhouette draws inspiration from Under Armour's performance heritage while introducing a bold, future-focused design language that feels as authentic and boundary-pushing as Gunna himself.


Gunna previously starred in Under Armour's ***[We Are Football](https://about.underarmour.com/en/stories/2025/09/under-armour-launches--we-are-football---a-global-salute-to-the-.html)*** campaign and most recently fronted the brand's ***[Bouncy Tee](https://about.underarmour.com/en/stories/2026/05/under-armour-advances-its-t-shirt-legacy-with-the-launch-of-the-.html)*** campaign alongside multi-platinum country artist Parker McCollum. Beyond campaigns, Under Armour has supported Gunna's mission to inspire the next generation to “push the pace” through initiatives including the ***[Wunna Run 5K](https://www.instagram.com/wunnarun/?hl=en)*** series during his recent global tour and ***Wunna Warriors*** , the artist's grassroots 7-on-7 high school football program.
